body.statement: The explicit confidence system in \(\mathrm{def{:}simultaneous\text{-}interval\text{-}handle}\) is total and computable and, for every admissible \(n,m,\tau\), satisfies \[\inf_{P\in\mathcal H_{\beta,D}(m)}\mathbb P_{P,n}\{\log V_{P,\tau}(\pi)\in I_{\pi}\text{ for every }\pi\in\Pi_m\}\ge1-\gamma_0.\] Uniformly over the class and along arbitrary admissible joint sequences, \[W_{n,m,\tau}=O_{\mathbb P_{P,n}}\!\left(\ell\min\{1,[m\log(40m)/n]^{\varkappa}\}+D\tau^{\beta/4}\right).\] Hence this exhibited system has \(W_{n,m,\tau}\to0\) in probability whenever \(\ell[m\log(40m)/n]^{\varkappa}\to0\). On the same simultaneous event, every data-dependent \(\widehat\pi\in\mathfrak A_{n,m}\), including \(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{tail}}\), satisfies \(\log V_{P,\tau}(\widehat\pi)\in I_{\widehat\pi}\); selected-policy coverage is therefore a corollary of the simultaneous theorem and requires no sample splitting.
body.justification: Bias-aware simultaneous survival regions yield selection-proof coverage without assuming Gaussian regularity at a changing extreme quantile.
body.gap: SasakiWang2024 covers one tail under worst-case bias and HuangLiPeng2025 covers a fixed collection of extreme treatment contrasts; neither indexes all capacity-feasible selected policy mixtures with heterogeneous local tail-index ties.
body.consumer: Every policy selected from the randomized sample, including the attaining tail learner, receives the displayed honest rare-loss certificate without sample splitting.
